title: Merck hikes revenue outlook as new drug sales grow, but cuts profit guidance due to deal charges
summary: Merck has revised its revenue expectations upward, attributing this growth to the successful sales of new pharmaceuticals. However, the company has simultaneously lowered its profit forecasts due to expenses associated with its acquisition of Terns Pharmaceuticals. This dual adjustment highlights the complexities of balancing revenue growth with the financial implications of strategic business decisions.
